==Description==
'''PVP''' was a test [[Maps|map]] for [[PVP Test]], having seven different variants with each game.

==Design & Path==
'''PVP''' was a map split into two parts. These parts were identical, except one was colored red while the other was blue, and the sides were flipped. It was a basic baseplate with multiple cliffs on it, though none of them actually counted as cliff spots. There was a large brick near the entrance, which acted as a cliff. 

The white path started and ended at the edge of the map.

==Strategy==
*Area of effect towers such as the [[Pyromancer]], [[Golden Pyromancer]] or [[Shotgunner]] are very useful, as they can help deal with the hordes of enemies that spawn in, whether naturally or by the enemy player.
*Cheap early game towers with high DPS like the [[Golden Cowboy]] and [[Engineer]] are very useful, allowing you to save up for more stronger towers or in the case of the Engineer be used for the entire round.
*Since you are able to get a lot of cash from the economy bonus, the [[Farm]], [[Cowboy]] and [[Golden Cowboy]] are unnecessary.
